kjv: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother
mine: the nakedness of your father, that is, the nakedness of your mother
note: Hebrew erwat avikha we'erwat immekha joins the two with waw; since the rest of the verse speaks only of the mother, the waw is best read as explicative (the mother's nakedness is the father's, cf. v. 8), whereas the KJV's "or" makes it two separate prohibitions including the father.

mine: to pass them over to Molech
note: Hebrew leha'avir lammolekh, "to cause to pass over/dedicate to Molech"; the KJV supplies "the fire" (as in Deut 18:10, 2 Kgs 23:10), which is a likely meaning but not stated here.
Hebrew tevel, a violation of the created order (from balal "mix"); "confusion" now suggests mere bewilderment.
